meta.title: Build: Use --follow-symlinks in VSCE
meta.body_summary: Add --follow-symlinks flag to vsce package to avoid copying PowerShell Editor Services modules during build, simplifying build scripts.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added --follow-symlinks but couldn't access review; maintainer CHANGES_REQUESTED, then closed as not ready.

core_change_summary.description: Added --follow-symlinks flag to vsce package command in package.json, simplified vscode-powershell.build.ps1 by removing symlink-to-copy conversion logic in Release and Package tasks, and unified debug/release build handling (incomplete).
change_trajectory: First substantive commit (bb42c6e): added --follow-symlinks to package command and simplified build.ps1 by removing copy logic.
Second commit (ff522a45): incorrectly added --follow-symlinks to publish command, which reviewer later flagged as unnecessary.

review_signals.summary: This no longer needs to be split between debug and release configurations since the logic will be shared.
Instead of orphaned comment, add an assertion that PSES modules exist under modules.
Copilot responded it doesn't have access to specific review comments and asked for details.
